name: Saint Elenda
description: Saint Elenda is a warrior nun who guarded the Immortal Sun and became the first vampire, revered as a saint by the Legion of Dusk and the Church of Dusk.

timeline.summary: Mavren Fein tells Manuel the legend of Saint Elenda, the nun who guarded the Immortal Sun and became the first vampire.
timeline.quote: She was born mortal, a warrior nun charged with her brothers and sisters of faith to guard the Immortal Sun in the mountains of Torrezon.
